decisions.label: Unlit forest brightness
decisions.note: What nothing lights (the moon and the dark only), times this (light.spooky.unlit; Ed's v5399 playtest, 2026-10-29: "The unlit forest needs to be darker"). 1 is as before; 0.7 as built, about a third darker, the lights (her glow, fires, the party, runestones, sigils) left as they were. Under 0.6 the crowns start to crush to black. Live.

decisions.label: Pointer dark plate
decisions.note: A dark disc and arrow under each edge pointer, so it reads over a lit or busy picture (pins.plate; Ed, 2026-10-29: "Also, it's easy to miss the pointers"). 0 is as before. Live.

decisions.label: Pointer vividness
decisions.note: How much of the pointers' calming (their colours dimmed toward the picture) is given back to their full neon (pins.vivid): 0 as before, 1 the raw colours. Live.
